description: lib/seed.js, scripts/seed-child.py and scripts/usdc-balance.py are new, tested, well-formed modules, but as of the current run.sh (see FIND-001) none of them are require()'d, sourced, or invoked from the skill's production entrypoint. grep across skills/self/spawn/run.sh for usdc-balance, seed-child, buildSeedPlan and finalizeSeedRow returns zero matches. This is the exact 'cron/skill exists but is never wired into the real path' anti-pattern this org's own memory calls out (feedback_earn_skill_must_have_verification_engine / HARD 0.24 NO FAKE RUN): unit-tested pure functions with no caller are dead code from the perspective of the actual product, and `node --test` passing on lib/__tests__/seed.test.js proves nothing about whether a real spawn ever seeds a child.
